title: Night market
description: A potion seller's stall in a toy market at night in the rain, where a lantern, a fire and two lamps cast point and spot shadows through one lighting. Poses blend a customer's walk and run by speed and play the seller's lantern, a wave on a tap and their breath on masked and additive layers, and a tap pulls the depth of field's focus before TAA and bloom finish the frame. The buildings, props, potions, people and clips are from Kay Lousberg's KayKit packs, and the table, lamps, string lights and logs from Kenney's kits (CC0).
line: A seller raises her lantern for a customer out of the rain; the potions are in focus and the market's lights blur into discs.
hint: tap a person to wave · tap to pull focus · drag to orbit · wheel to zoom
